headline: The WNBA field: Lynx 31-10, playoffs 27 September
whyCareReason: September basketball in 2026 is the women's game. Eight teams, a 27 September start, Minnesota still on top at 31-10.
teaser: Seeds as of 20 September: Lynx 31-10, Valkyries 31-11, Aces 28-13, Dream 28-14, Fever 27-14, Wings 26-16, Liberty 25-16, Mystics 25-16.
story:
Why this one matters: the NBA is in its offseason. The WNBA has an eight-team field and the playoffs begin 27 September. Regular-season games remain on the WNBA.com board through 24 September.

Wikipedia qualifying table, 20 September: Minnesota Lynx 31-10, Golden State Valkyries 31-11, Las Vegas Aces 28-13, Atlanta Dream 28-14, Indiana Fever 27-14, Dallas Wings 26-16, New York Liberty 25-16, Washington Mystics 25-16. First round is best of three. Semifinals best of five. Finals best of seven for the second time.

The Aces are the defending champions from 2025. The Lynx have the one-seed. The Valkyries, in year two, have the two-seed. Do not invent a 2026 champion. The playoff games have not started.
stakes: Home court, a one-seed, a 27 September start.
rivalryAngle: Lynx versus a field that includes last year's champions and a second-year Valkyries side.
